Sources — IGCC _Daily Summary → Cat.inc (city × date FnV ORDERS_TOTAL + ORDERS_IGCC) drives all PAN/city numbers; Item incidences (item × city × date) drives the item table. PAN/City IGCC% = Σ ORDERS_IGCC ÷ Σ ORDERS_TOTAL — the official orders-based incidence. Target 0.99%.
Note — Cat.inc spans 01 Aug–30 Aug; Item incidences spans 28 Aug–30 Aug — for days outside the item window the item table is empty while PAN/city numbers still show. Export buttons download the current filtered view as CSV.
SPOC RCA — IGCC/unique-orders % per SPOC bucket (CX · Pod · Sourcing · WH) from Appsheet Summary (16 Aug–26 Aug). Article rows use item-level daily source; City & POD rows use weekly city-level summary. Higher % = more IGCC attributed to that SPOC.
